notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Hollow Sentinel, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
